axes.model_access: The consumer app and API share the official V4 family. The API model page lists `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, text and image input) and `deepseek-v4-pro` (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, text input). Both are at 1M context, up to 384K output and thinking mode by default. The app and web can switch to V4 Pro via Expert mode. Open weights are the same vendor’s other face, with local runs covered by runner entries (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web at chat.deepseek.com, iOS/Android apps and the API all work. The API base is `https://api.deepseek.com`, compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages. Generation runs in the vendor cloud with no local model (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Chat history, uploads and images live account-side in the cloud. The privacy policy lets users copy or delete chat history in settings. On the API side inputs are processed per request, with file parsing done server-side and folded into context. The product itself hosts no local model files (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Conversations stream and long answers generate within the session. There is no separate offline task queue. Deep thinking is a per-request reasoning level (low/high/max), not an async job. Cloud task agents belong to DeepSeek Harness, a separate entry (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: The app and web product support web search, file input (PDF/Office/images), link reading, voice interaction and safety checks. The same capabilities are available as API tools: `deepseek_web_search`, `deepseek_read_url`, file parsing, OCR, ASR and TTS. The API also offers JSON Output, Tool Calls, chat prefix completion and Responses/Anthropic compatibility (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Context is counted per conversation and model window. The V4 family has 1M context and up to 384K output. History is stored per conversation, synced across devices after login and can be copied or deleted in settings. The official feature surface only covers single-session context and history; cross-session reuse is manual (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: An account (email, phone or third-party login) allows free use. The API bills per token on peak/off-peak pricing: weekday 9–12 and 14–18 Beijing time are peak, other hours half price. The privacy policy lets users manage chat history and opt out of training. The terms assign Output rights to the user and require accuracy checks plus AI-origin labelling when redistributing (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: Chinese reasoning and long documents, 1M context, official model docs and dual OpenAI/Anthropic protocols, with API and open weights from the same family. Not fit: cross-session memory, background long tasks or workflows, or office-suite integration (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the DeepSeek site, V4 release and API docs, privacy policy and terms. Per-platform app differences, practical long-context capacity and peak/off-peak billing need account-level testing.
